Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (6g), Calcium, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Corn tortilla chips (Totopos), Guajillo & Ancho dried chillies, Roma tomatoes, Garlic, Onion, Queso Cotija / Fresh cheese, Crema Mexicana, Fried eggs, Cilantro, Vegetable oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Rehydrate dried chillies and blend with charred tomatoes, garlic, onion, and salt into a smooth red salsa. 2. Simmer salsa in a pan, toss in crispy corn tortilla chips until lightly coated and warmed through. 3. Top with a fried egg, crumbled queso cotija, drizzled crema, and fresh cilantro.

Key Nutrients: Protein (9g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (45g), Fiber (8g), Vitamin C, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Corn tortilla chips, Tomatillos (husk tomatoes), Jalapeños / Serrano chillies, Garlic, White onion, Cilantro, Vegan cashew crema, Sliced avocado, Black beans
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil tomatillos, serrano chillies, garlic, and onion; blend with fresh cilantro into green salsa (salsa verde). 2. Simmer green salsa in a skillet, gently fold in crispy tortilla chips. 3. Top with fresh avocado slices, warm black beans, and drizzled cashew crema.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (7g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Warm corn tortillas or flour tortilla, Crumbled paneer / Tofu, Bell peppers, Sweet corn, Cumin powder, Mexican oregano, Tomatoes, Jalapeño, Cilantro, Monterey Jack cheese, Sour cream
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté diced bell peppers, sweet corn, and crumbled paneer with cumin, oregano, and salt (no onion, garlic, or mushroom). 2. Prepare fresh salsa with diced tomatoes, jalapeños, lime juice, and cilantro. 3. Assemble sautéed filling and fresh salsa into warm tortillas, top with cheese and sour cream.

Key Nutrients: Protein (26g), Fat (32g), Carbohydrates (34g), Fiber (6g), Iron, Vitamin A
Ingredients Required: Corn tortillas, Fried eggs, Mexican Pork Chorizo, Refried pinto beans, Fire-roasted tomatoes, Jalapeños, Garlic, Onion, Queso fresco, Avocado
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté chorizo and mix with warm refried beans. 2. Blend fire-roasted tomatoes, jalapeños, garlic, and onion into a spicy ranchero sauce; simmer. 3. Lightly fry corn tortillas, spread refried beans & chorizo layer, place sunny-side-up fried eggs on top, smother with hot ranchero sauce, and garnish with cheese and avocado.

Key Nutrients: Protein (16g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (68g), Fiber (12g), Folate, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Cilantro lime rice, Black beans, Fajita veggies (Bell peppers, Onions), Pico de Gallo (tomatoes, onion, cilantro, lime), Guacamole, Shredded Cheddar, Sour cream, Shredded lettuce
Recipe Instructions: 1. Cook rice with lime juice and chopped cilantro. Sauté sliced bell peppers and onions with fajita seasoning. 2. Layer bowl with cilantro lime rice, seasoned black beans, and fajita veggies. 3. Top with freshly mashed guacamole, pico de gallo, cheese, and sour cream.

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (15g), Carbohydrates (62g), Fiber (11g), Vit C, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Cilantro lime rice, Black beans, Bell peppers (Red, Yellow, Green), Zucchini, Sweet corn, Tomato salsa (diced tomatoes, jalapeños, lime, cilantro, oregano), Guacamole, Shredded cheese
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté sliced bell peppers, zucchini, and corn with oregano, cumin, and salt (no garlic/onion). 2. Prepare Jain salsa using diced tomatoes, jalapeños, lime, and cilantro. 3. Build bowl: rice, black beans, sautéed veggies, guacamole, and tomato salsa.

Key Nutrients: Protein (13g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (60g), Fiber (14g), Iron, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Corn tortillas, Black beans, Sweet corn, Roasted poblano peppers, Ancho chilli powder, Cumin, Tomato puree, Garlic, Vegan cheese / Nutritional yeast, Avocado
Recipe Instructions: 1. Make red enchilada sauce by simmering tomato puree, garlic, ancho chilli powder, cumin, and broth. 2. Mix black beans, corn, and diced poblano peppers with spices for filling. 3. Dip corn tortillas in sauce, fill, roll, place in baking dish, smother with sauce, top with vegan cheese, and bake at 190°C (375°F) for 20 mins.

Key Nutrients: Protein (30g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (36g), Fiber (4g), Vitamin B12, Zinc
Ingredients Required: Pork shoulder (thinly sliced), Achiote paste, Guajillo chillies, Pineapple juice, White vinegar, Fresh pineapple slices, Small corn tortillas, Chopped onions, Cilantro, Lime wedges
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate pork in a blended paste of hydrated guajillo chillies, achiote paste, pineapple juice, vinegar, and spices for 4+ hours. 2. Sear thinly sliced marinated pork and roasted pineapple on a piping hot skillet/grill till charred. 3. Serve on warm corn tortillas topped with roasted pineapple, onions, cilantro, and lime.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (28g), Fiber (9g), Healthy Monounsaturated Fats, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Ripe Hass avocados, Lime juice, Diced white onion, Jalapeño / Serrano chillies, Fresh cilantro, Sea salt, Crisp corn tortilla chips
Recipe Instructions: 1. Halve and pit avocados; scoop flesh into a bowl and mash coarsely with a fork. 2. Fold in finely diced white onion, seedless jalapeños, chopped cilantro, fresh lime juice, and sea salt. 3. Serve immediately with warm, crispy corn tortilla chips.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (26g), Fiber (9g), Vit C, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Ripe Hass avocados, Fresh lime juice, Finely diced tomatoes, Diced green chillies / Jalapeños, Fresh cilantro, Cumin powder, Sea salt, Corn tortilla chips
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mash ripe avocados with fresh lime juice, salt, and a pinch of cumin powder. 2. Gently fold in diced tomatoes, green chillies, and cilantro (strictly no onion or garlic). 3. Serve fresh with crispy corn tortilla chips.

Key Nutrients: Protein (16g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (30g), Fiber (2g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Flour tortillas, Shredded Oaxaca / Monterey Jack cheese, Butter / Oil, Salsa, Sour cream
Recipe Instructions: 1. Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat, place flour tortilla. 2. Generously cover half of tortilla with shredded cheese, fold in half into a half-moon. 3. Cook until tortilla is golden crisp on both sides and cheese is gooey melted. Serve with salsa and sour cream.

Key Nutrients: Protein (22g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (36g), Fiber (3g), Iron, Niacin
Ingredients Required: Empanada dough discs, Shredded cooked chicken, Diced tomatoes, Onions, Garlic, Cumin, Smoked paprika, Olives, Egg wash, Frying oil / Baking
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté onions, garlic, tomatoes, chicken, cumin, paprika, and chopped olives until thick. 2. Place filling in center of dough discs, fold over, crimp edges with a fork. 3. Deep fry until golden or brush with egg wash and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20 mins.

Dish Name: Vegetarian Mole Poblano with Mexican Rice
Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (24g), Carbohydrates (60g), Fiber (10g), Iron, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Roasted Vegetables (Plantain, Zucchini, Sweet potato) or Tofu, Dried Mulato, Ancho & Pasilla chillies, Dark Mexican Chocolate, Plantain, Sesame seeds, Nuts (Almonds, Pumpkin seeds), Spices (Cinnamon, Cloves), Vegetable broth, Mexican Rice
Recipe Instructions: 1. Toast dried chillies, nuts, seeds, spices, plantain, and blend with vegetable broth into a complex paste. 2. Simmer sauce in oil and melt in Mexican dark chocolate to create velvety Mole sauce. 3. Toss roasted vegetables/tofu in Mole sauce and serve with tomato-flavored Mexican rice.

Key Nutrients: Protein (13g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (54g), Fiber (8g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Large flour tortilla, Black beans, Bell peppers, Sweet corn, Monterey Jack cheese, Cumin, Oregano, Oil for shallow frying, Fresh tomato-jalapeño salsa, Sour cream
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté bell peppers, corn, and black beans with cumin, oregano, and salt. 2. Place filling and cheese inside tortilla, fold into a tight rectangular parcel. 3. Shallow fry parcel in oil until golden crisp on all sides. Serve hot with fresh tomato salsa and sour cream.

Dish Name: Birria de Res (Beef / Mutton Stew & Tacos)
Key Nutrients: Protein (42g), Fat (36g), Carbohydrates (26g), Fiber (4g), Iron, Zinc, Vit B12
Ingredients Required: Mutton / Beef chuck roast, Dried Guajillo & Ancho chillies, Tomatoes, Garlic, Onion, Cinnamon stick, Cloves, Mexican Oregano, Vinegar, Corn tortillas, Melted Oaxaca cheese, Chopped cilantro
Recipe Instructions: 1. Blend rehydrated chillies, roasted tomatoes, garlic, onion, vinegar, and spices into a marinade. Slow cook meat in broth & marinade for 3-4 hours until shreddable (Birria stew). 2. Dip corn tortillas into layer of fat floating on consommé, place on flat grill, add cheese and shredded meat, fold into crispy Quesabirria tacos. Serve with consommé broth for dipping.

Key Nutrients: Protein (28g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (40g), Fiber (4g), Vit D, Phosphorus
Ingredients Required: White fish fillets (Cod/Mahi Mahi), Beer batter (flour, beer, baking powder, spices), Shredded red cabbage, Lime juice, Chipotle mayo (mayo, chipotle in adobo, lime), Corn tortillas, Cilantro
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mix shredded cabbage with lime juice and salt. Whisk mayo with chipotle in adobo. 2. Dip fish strips in crisp beer batter and deep fry until light and crunchy. 3. Assemble on warm corn tortillas with crunchy cabbage slaw, fried fish, chipotle mayo, and fresh cilantro.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (2g), Sodium
Ingredients Required: Water, Butter, All-purpose flour, Eggs (or eggless substitute), Sugar, Cinnamon powder, Oil for deep frying, Dark chocolate, Heavy cream
Recipe Instructions: 1. Cook water, butter, and flour into a smooth dough choux paste; cool slightly and pipe through a star tip into hot oil. 2. Deep fry until golden brown and crispy. 3. Immediately roll hot churros in cinnamon-sugar mix and serve with warm chocolate dipping sauce.

Dish Name: Jain Eggless Churros with Chocolate Sauce
Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (17g), Carbohydrates (51g), Fiber (2g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Water, Butter/Oil, All-purpose flour (Maida), Sugar, Cinnamon powder, Oil for frying, Cocoa powder / Eggless dark chocolate, Milk
Recipe Instructions: 1. Bring water, sugar, and butter to a boil; stir in flour until dough ball forms. 2. Pipe dough using star tip into hot oil and fry till crispy golden. 3. Toss in cinnamon sugar and serve with warm eggless chocolate sauce.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (0g), Calcium, Vit A
Ingredients Required: Flour, Eggs, Sugar, Whole milk, Evaporated milk, Sweetened Condensed milk, Heavy whipping cream, Vanilla extract, Cinnamon / Strawberries for garnish
Recipe Instructions: 1. Bake a light sponge cake and let cool; pierce all over with a fork. 2. Whisk together evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk, and whole milk (three milks). 3. Pour milk mixture over sponge cake until completely soaked, chill overnight, and top with whipped cream and cinnamon.

Key Nutrients: Protein (9g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (46g), Fiber (0g), Calcium, Vit A
Ingredients Required: Sugar (for caramel), Whole Eggs, Evaporated milk, Sweetened Condensed milk, Cream cheese (for Flan de Queso), Vanilla extract
Recipe Instructions: 1. Caramelize sugar in a pan until amber; pour into ramekins. 2. Blend eggs, evaporated milk, condensed milk, cream cheese, and vanilla until smooth. 3. Pour custard over caramel, bake in a water bath (Baño María) at 175°C (350°F) for 50 mins, chill, and invert onto plates.
